migration_strategy.rule: Every field whose value claims byte provenance becomes a SourceSpanReferenceV1. V1 strings and V2 references are never accepted through a union in the same schema.
migration_strategy.v1_status: Frozen historical/evaluation evidence remains validated and interpreted under its original V1 contract.
migration_strategy.v2_status: Future candidate only; no authority exists until separately implemented, verified, rebound, and approved.

field_migration_matrix.reason: Defines the exact construction extent used for host/return overlap checks.
Anchors every classified proposition or contained-creative entry in immutable commentary bytes.
Cites governed support without permitting authority bytes to populate candidate evidence.
Anchors the exact creative vehicle used for host and target reconciliation.

fields_that_remain_model_authored_analys.purpose: Normalized proposition description used for semantic classification.
fields_that_remain_model_authored_analys.boundary: It is not a source quotation, membership proof, or factual authority even when wording overlaps a source.

fields_that_remain_model_authored_analys.purpose: Model-authored description of what a creative vehicle targets.
fields_that_remain_model_authored_analys.boundary: A REAL_WORLD_PROPOSITION target still requires reconciliation to a proposition entry and cannot acquire support from this text.

fields_that_remain_model_authored_analys.purpose: Concise explanation for the construction-role classification.
fields_that_remain_model_authored_analys.boundary: Quoted or paraphrased fragments inside the explanation carry no provenance; machine checks use references only.

fields_that_remain_model_authored_analys.purpose: Explanation when no material creative construction is found.
fields_that_remain_model_authored_analys.boundary: It cannot stand in for a candidate reference or create a ledger entry.

v2_shape_rules: The four V1 provenance field names are absent from the V2 model; their reference-field replacements are mandatory except nullable authority_support_ref.
A reference source_sha256 must equal the case-bound identity for its required source role.
No free-text fallback, ENTIRE_COMMENTARY sentinel, normalized offset, character offset, token offset, or inferred source role is accepted.
A whole-commentary span is represented by CANDIDATE byte offsets [0, candidate_byte_length).
IDs and all existing semantic enums, graph links, cardinality limits, coverage receipts, and coherence rules remain conceptually unchanged.
Overlap is computed from resolved half-open byte intervals in the same source, never by searching copied text.
Cross-source intervals never overlap and cannot satisfy host/return, vehicle/host, or construction/entry reconciliation.
Repeated identical text remains occurrence-specific because coordinates, not substring search, define position.

inputs: Exact raw V2 model-response bytes and SHA-256.
Exact case-bound candidate and factual-authority bytes, roles, lengths, and SHA-256 identities.
Approved SourceSpanReferenceV1 schema identity and pure resolver identity.
ordered_phases: Persist raw response exclusively before parsing or projection.
Validate the strict V2 reference-bearing JSON schema without altering raw bytes.
Resolve every reference independently against its required immutable source role.
Persist one projection receipt that binds the raw response, both sources, resolver, and every field projection.
Run graph overlap, source-role, semantic coherence, and coverage validation over resolved coordinates and model-authored classifications.
Persist a separate semantic receipt and then a terminal phase receipt using fail-closed precedence.
projection_pipeline_design.no_partial_admission: Every required reference must resolve. One projection failure makes projection FAIL for the ledger; successfully resolved siblings remain recorded as evidence but grant no partial admission.
projection_pipeline_design.determinism: The same raw response bytes, source bytes, schema, and resolver identities must produce the same ordered projection receipt bytes.

receipt_fields: raw model-response SHA-256 and byte length
candidate source SHA-256 and byte length
factual-authority source SHA-256 and byte length
reference schema identity and resolver identity
ordered projection records sorted by canonical JSON pointer
terminal projection status and stable reason code
per_projection_record: canonical JSON pointer to the reference field
projection_receipt_v1_design.projected_text_policy: Do not duplicate projected text in the canonical receipt. Human-readable tools may render it on demand from the immutable source and recorded coordinates.
projection_receipt_v1_design.materialized_legacy_view: Not part of V2 authority. If separately needed for diagnostics, it must be derived, separately hashed, clearly labeled non-raw, and never passed off as the model response or used to mutate frozen V1 evidence.
projection_receipt_v1_design.append_only_rule: The receipt is exclusively created beside raw output. It never overwrites, repairs, or normalizes the raw response or source files.

receipt_coexistence_and_precedence.raw_receipt: Authoritative record of exactly what the model returned; success means persistence only.
receipt_coexistence_and_precedence.schema_receipt: Reports strict V2 parsing independently from transport and persistence.
receipt_coexistence_and_precedence.projection_receipt: Reports whether all references deterministically resolve to correct immutable sources.
receipt_coexistence_and_precedence.semantic_receipt: Reports graph, scope, event-alignment, target, construction, and coverage judgments after projection.
receipt_coexistence_and_precedence.preservation_rule: A later failure never rewrites an earlier success. For example, Case 01 may retain transport SUCCESS, raw SUCCESS, schema SUCCESS, projection SUCCESS, and semantic FAIL as separate facts.

case01_design_acceptance_contract: The full commentary can be referenced independently by construction C1, entries P1 and P2, and target T1 without copying any commentary bytes into those fields.
All four references may share identical CANDIDATE coordinates; overlap reconciliation uses coordinates and succeeds deterministically.
The model-authored angazații approximation cannot become projected evidence because no provenance-bearing text field exists in V2.
An authority_support_ref, when non-null, resolves only against FACTUAL_AUTHORITY; it cannot populate candidate_span_ref or vehicle_span_ref.
Projection success does not alter or excuse the observed semantic event_alignment issue; NEW_UNSUPPORTED_EVENT versus GOVERNED_EVENT remains an independent semantic decision.
The frozen V1 raw output and its membership-failure receipt remain unchanged and are never retroactively reclassified through V2.
bounded_future_sequence_recommendation: If separately authorized, implement only frozen V2 ledger models plus a pure ledger projector/receipt builder over captured fixtures; do not bind an evaluator or grammar.
Verify JSON-pointer completeness: every provenance-bearing field is projected exactly once and no free-text analysis field is projected as evidence.
Verify deterministic receipt bytes, field-role rejection, repeated-span coordinates, all-or-nothing projection status, and preservation of frozen raw bytes.
Use a hand-constructed reference-bearing Case 01 fixture for contract verification only; do not convert or repair the frozen model output and do not claim it as a generated result.
Stop for owner review before any constrained grammar/projector, prompt migration, evaluator/runner rebinding, probe construction, or inference.
explicit_non_goals: No implementation of V2 ledger models, projection receipts, adapters, grammar, prompt, evaluator, runner, or runtime path in this design step.
No conversion, repair, replacement, or re-adjudication of frozen V1 raw evidence.
No probe, retry, model call, Stage C, curriculum exposure, production authority, or training.
